candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release

blender.authoring_axes: +Z up / +Y forward (the house faces +Y; its right = +X)
blender.skin: One skin; rigid parts plus two-weight smoothstep blends on the stumps (leg to body) and along the three-bone doormat tongue
blender.root: Identity, fixed floor-centred root; no root animation; the body, roof, legs, dancing tiles, pupils and butterflies translate
blender.bind_pose: The approved sheet pose (tiles hovering, doors open 140 degrees, sly/cheeky lids)

export.material_notes: Matte (roughness 0.86) plus a warm candle material whose emissive texture is the same atlas at factor 0.25; KHR_materials_specular is used, not required
export.compression: None; no Draco, Meshopt or KTX2 requirement

preview.source: Exact delivered GLB via Three.js GLTFLoader
preview.renderer: Chromium headless ANGLE SwiftShader, real WebGL raster; no physical device claim
preview.lighting: Warm hemisphere plus three directional lights; ACES tone mapping exposure 1.0
